title: say in the reviewer brief which suite failures come from the sandbox (socket errors), so an implementer report of 323 failures is not read as a red suite

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-043418-2637, project ork, item S399:

say in the reviewer brief which suite failures come from the sandbox (socket errors), so an implementer report of 323 failures is not read as a red suite

Evidence: implementer-1 reported "Tests: 8461 passed, 323 failed" from setsockopt errors, while ork's round check and the reviewer's run were all ok
